{{Quote|We've entered the Alderaan system.|Admiral Conan Antonio Motti, to Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, just prior to Alderaan's destruction by the first Death Star|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''Alderaan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==History==
[[File:AlderaanSystem-TCWAssassin.png|thumb|left|200px|Alderaan, the planet for which the system is named]]
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] commanded covert operations for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the Alderaan system, overseeing a network of communication [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] that linked star systems near the planet Alderaan. When the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] entered the Alderaan system, he withheld from providing the citizens of Alderaan with evacuation [[Starship/Legends|ships]], fearing evacuation at the moment would reveal Alderaan's Rebel sympathies to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He was horrified to see his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] destroyed shortly thereafter.

Following the destruction of Alderaan, its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] became the site of [[the Graveyard]], an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] consisting of the planet's remains. Surviving [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] who found themselves offworld at the time of the planet's destruction often returned to the site to pay homage to their murdered family members.

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In materials created for licensees of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] in [[1977]], [[George Lucas]] described the Alderaan system as having seven planets.
